title: Level Monthly Payment Plan Settings in the Refined Fuels Catalogue
content:
A level monthly payment plan is carried only on the programmes the catalogue for Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts writes it on. For each programme the catalogue fixes whether the plan is carried, how many monthly instalments the plan year runs over, the month and day the plan year begins, the month and day the plan is trued up against actual use, and the share of the estimated year paid at enrolment.

| Programme | Level payment plan | Instalments in the plan year | Plan year begins | Trued up on | Down payment, percent of the estimated year |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Will-Call Propane Account | not carried | 0 | not offered | not offered | 0 |
| Keep-Full Automatic Delivery Account | not carried | 0 | not offered | not offered | 0 |
| Budget Payment Plan Account | carried | 11 | 1 August | 15 July | 10 |
| Contract Gallon Pre-Buy Account | carried | 11 | 1 August | 15 July | 25 |
| Bulk Farm Fuel Delivery Account | not carried | 0 | not offered | not offered | 0 |
| Cardtrol Fleet Fueling Account | not carried | 0 | not offered | not offered | 0 |

## Notes

1. Two programmes carry the plan: the Budget Payment Plan Account and the Contract Gallon Pre-Buy Account. Both run 11 instalments, both begin the plan year on 1 August and both are trued up on 15 July.
2. The two differ only in the down payment, which stands at 10 percent of the estimated year on the Budget Payment Plan Account and at 25 percent on the Contract Gallon Pre-Buy Account.
3. On the four programmes that do not carry the plan, the instalment count and the down payment stand at 0 and neither a start date nor a true-up date is offered.
